# Esther Chapter 9 — The EMET Bible (Literal)
**Translator:** EMET | **Source:** Leningrad Codex (B19A), Folios 458v–459r | **Source Image:** source-texts/hebrew-OT/EST_009_page_001.jpg

---

**9:1** And-in-the-twelfth [bi-shnem asar] month — it [is] the-month of-Adar — on-the-thirteenth [bi-sheloshah asar] day in-it, when the-word [devar] of-the-king and-his-law [ve-dato] reached [higgia] to-be-done [le-he'asot], on-the-day [ba-yom] that the-enemies [oyvey] of-the-Yehudim had-hoped [sivru] to-have-power [lishlot] over-them, and-it-was-reversed [ve-nahafokh] — it [hu] — that the-Yehudim had-power [yishletu] they [hemmah] over-the-ones-hating-them [be-son'eyhem].

**9:2** The-Yehudim assembled [niqhalu] in-their-cities [be-areyhem] in-all the-provinces [medinot] of-the-king Achashverosh, to-stretch [lishloach] a-hand [yad] against-the-ones-seeking [be-mevaqqeshey] their-harm [ra'atam], and-no man [ish] stood [amad] before-them [lifneyhem], for their-fear [pachdam] had-fallen [nafal] upon all the-peoples [ha-ammim]. **9:3** And-all the-princes [sarey] of-the-provinces and-the-satraps [ha-achashdarpanim] and-the-governors [ha-pachot] and-the-doers [osey] of-the-work [ha-melakhah] of-the-king [were] lifting-up [menasse'im] the-Yehudim, for the-fear [pachad] of-Mordekhai had-fallen [nafal] upon-them. **9:4** For great [gadol] [was] Mordekhai in-the-house [be-veyt] of-the-king, and-his-fame [shom'o] was-going [holekh] in-all the-provinces, for the-man [ha-ish] Mordekhai was-going [holekh] and-becoming-great [ve-gadol].

**9:5** And-the-Yehudim struck [va-yakku] in-all their-enemies [oyveyhem] a-striking [makkat] of-sword [cherev] and-slaughter [ve-hereg] and-destruction [ve-avdan], and-they-did [va-ya'asu] in-the-ones-hating-them [be-son'eyhem] as-they-pleased [ki-retsonam].

**9:6** And-in-Shushan the-citadel [ha-birah] the-Yehudim slew [hargu] and-destroyed [ve-abbed] five hundred [chamesh me'ot] men [ish]. **9:7** And-Parshandatha, and-Dalfon, and-Aspata, **9:8** and-Porata, and-Adalya, and-Aridata, **9:9** and-Parmashta, and-Arisai, and-Aridai, and-Vaizata — **9:10** ten [aseret] sons [beney] of-Haman son of-Hammedatha, the-adversary [tsorer] of-the-Yehudim, they-slew [hargu]; and-on-the-plunder [ba-bizzah] they-did-not stretch [lo-shalechu] their-hand [et-yadam].

**9:11** On-that day [ba-yom ha-hu] the-number [mispar] of-the-slain [ha-harugim] in-Shushan the-citadel came [ba] before [lifney] the-king. **9:12** And-the-king said to-Ester the-queen, "In-Shushan the-citadel the-Yehudim have-slain and-destroyed five hundred men and-the-ten sons of-Haman. In-the-rest [bi-she'ar] of-the-provinces [medinot] of-the-king, what have-they-done [meh asu]? And-what [is] your-petition [she'elatekh]? And-it-shall-be-given [ve-yinnaten] to-you. And-what [is] your-request [baqqashatekh] further [od]? And-it-shall-be-done [ve-te'as]."

**9:13** And-Ester said, "If upon the-king [it-is] good, let-it-be-given [yinnaten] also tomorrow [machar] to-the-Yehudim who [are] in-Shushan to-do [la'asot] according-to-the-law [ke-dat] of-today [ha-yom], and-the-ten sons of-Haman let-them-hang [yitlu] on the-gallows [ha-ets]." **9:14** And-the-king said to-do [le-he'asot] thus [ken], and-a-law [dat] was-given in-Shushan, and-the-ten sons of-Haman they-hanged [talu].

**9:15** And-the-Yehudim who [were] in-Shushan assembled [va-yiqqahalu] also on-the-fourteenth [be-yom arba'ah asar] day of-the-month of-Adar, and-they-slew [va-yahargu] in-Shushan three hundred [shelosh me'ot] men [ish], and-on-the-plunder they-did-not stretch their-hand.

**9:16** And-the-rest [u-she'ar] of-the-Yehudim who [were] in-the-provinces [bi-medinot] of-the-king assembled [niqhalu] and-stood [ve-amad] for their-lives [al-nafsham], and-had-rest [ve-noach] from their-enemies [me-oyveyhem], and-slew [ve-harog] among-the-ones-hating-them [be-son'eyhem] five and-seventy thousand [chamishshah ve-shiv'im elef], and-on-the-plunder they-did-not stretch their-hand.

**9:17** On-the-thirteenth [bi-sheloshah asar] day of-the-month of-Adar, and-resting [ve-noach] on-the-fourteenth [be-arba'ah asar] day in-it, and-making-it [ve-asoh] a-day of-feasting [mishteh] and-gladness [ve-simchah].

**9:18** And-the-Yehudim who [were] in-Shushan assembled on-the-thirteenth day in-it and-on-the-fourteenth day in-it, and-resting on-the-fifteenth [ba-chamishah asar] day in-it, and-making-it a-day of-feasting and-gladness.

**9:19** Therefore [al-ken] the-Yehudim of-the-open-towns [ha-perazim], the-ones-dwelling [ha-yoshevim] in-the-cities [be-arey] of-the-open-country [ha-perazot], are-making [osim] the-fourteenth day of-the-month of-Adar [a day of] gladness [simchah] and-feasting [mishteh] and-a-good [tov] day [yom] and-of-sending [u-mishlach] portions [manot] each-to-his-neighbor [ish le-re'ehu].

**9:20** And-Mordekhai wrote [va-yikhtov] these things [ha-devarim ha-elleh] and-sent [va-yishlach] letters [sefarim] to all the-Yehudim who [were] in-all the-provinces of-the-king Achashverosh, the-near [ha-qerovim] and-the-far [ve-ha-rechoqim], **9:21** to-establish [le-qayyem] upon-them to-be doing [la'asot] the-fourteenth day of-the-month of-Adar and-the-fifteenth day in-it, in-every year and-year [be-khol shanah ve-shanah], **9:22** as-the-days [ka-yamim] on-which the-Yehudim rested [nachu] from their-enemies, and-the-month [ve-ha-chodesh] which was-turned [nehpakh] for-them from-sorrow [mi-yagon] to-gladness [le-simchah] and-from-mourning [me-evel] to-a-good [tov] day — to-make them [la'asot otam] days of-feasting [mishteh] and-gladness and-sending [mishlach] of-portions [manot] each-to-his-neighbor [ish le-re'ehu] and-gifts [u-mattanot] to-the-poor [la-evyonim].

**9:23** And-the-Yehudim accepted [ve-qibbel] what they-had-begun [hechelu] to-do [la'asot] and-what Mordekhai had-written [katav] to-them. **9:24** For Haman son of-Hammedatha the-Agagi, the-adversary [tsorer] of-all the-Yehudim, had-plotted [chashav] against the-Yehudim to-destroy-them [le-abbedam], and-he-had-cast [ve-hippil] Pur — it [is] the-lot [ha-goral] — to-crush-them [le-hummam] and-to-destroy-them [u-le-abbedam]. **9:25** And-when-she-came [u-ve-vo'ah] before [lifney] the-king, he-said [amar] with the-letter [im-ha-sefer]: let-his-evil-plot [machashavto ha-ra'ah] which he-plotted [chashav] against the-Yehudim return [yashuv] on his-own-head [al-rosho]; and-they-hanged [ve-talu] him and-his-sons [ve-et-banav] on the-gallows [ha-ets].

**9:26** Therefore [al-ken] they-called [qare'u] these days [la-yamim ha-elleh] Purim, after [al-shem] the-name of-the-Pur. Therefore, because-of [al-ken al-kol] all the-words [divrey] of-this letter [ha-iggeret ha-zo't], and-what they-had-seen [ra'u] concerning this [al-kakhah], and-what had-reached [higgia] to-them [aleihem], **9:27** the-Yehudim established [qiyyemu] and-accepted [ve-qibbelu] upon-them and-upon their-seed [zar'am] and-upon all the-ones-joining [ha-nilvim] upon-them, and-it-shall-not pass-away [ve-lo ya'avor], to-be doing [la'asot] these two [sheney] days [ha-yamim] according-to-their-writing [ki-khetavam] and-according-to-their-time [ki-zemannam] in-every year and-year.

**9:28** And-these days [are] remembered [nizkarim] and-done [ve-na'asim] in-every generation and-generation [be-khol dor va-dor], family and-family [mishpachah u-mishpachah], province and-province [medinah u-medinah], and-city and-city [ve-ir va-ir]; and-these days of-the-Purim shall-not pass-away [lo ya'avru] from-the-midst [mi-tokh] of-the-Yehudim, and-their-memory [ve-zikhram] shall-not come-to-an-end [lo-yasuf] from their-seed [mi-zar'am].

**9:29** And-Ester the-queen, daughter of-Avichayil, and-Mordekhai the-Yehudi wrote [va-tikhtov] with-all authority [tokef] to-confirm [le-qayyem] this letter [iggeret] of-the-Purim the-second [ha-shenit ha-zo't]. **9:30** And-he-sent [va-yishlach] letters [sefarim] to all the-Yehudim, to the-seven and-twenty and-hundred provinces [medinot] of-the-kingdom [malkhut] of-Achashverosh — words [divrey] of-peace [shalom] and-truth [ve-emet] — **9:31** to-confirm [le-qayyem] these days of-the-Purim in-their-times [bi-zemanneyhem], as Mordekhai the-Yehudi had-established [qiyyam] upon-them and-Ester the-queen, and-as they-had-established [qiyyemu] upon their-own-selves [al-nafsham] and-upon their-seed [zar'am], the-matters [divrey] of-the-fastings [ha-tsomot] and-their-outcry [ve-za'aqatam]. **9:32** And-the-command [ma'amar] of-Ester confirmed [qiyyam] these matters [divrey] of-the-Purim, and-it-was-written [ve-nikhtav] in-the-book [ba-sefer].

## EMET's Textual Notes

**v.1 — "ve-nahafokh hu" (and it was reversed):** This phrase is the thematic key to the entire book of Esther. The word *nahafokh* (reversal/overturning) encapsulates the complete inversion of fortune: what was intended for destruction becomes salvation. In Jewish tradition, this phrase became a byword for the Purim celebration itself.

**v.10, 15, 16 — "on the plunder they did not stretch their hand":** This refrain appears three times, emphasizing that the Jews fought only in self-defense and did not enrich themselves — a deliberate contrast with Haman's promise to deposit ten thousand talents into the royal treasury (3:9). The restraint echoes Saul's failure to obey the ban against Amalekite plunder (1 Samuel 15), subtly correcting an ancient wrong.

**v.24 — "Pur — it is the lot":** The narrator glosses the Persian word *Pur* with the Hebrew *goral* (lot), indicating that the audience needs the translation. This is evidence that the text was composed for Hebrew-speaking Jews unfamiliar with Persian terminology.

**v.26 — "Purim, after the name of the Pur":** The festival name is derived from the implement of Haman's plan — the casting of lots. The irony is embedded in the name itself: the instrument of intended destruction becomes the name of the celebration of deliverance.

*— EMET*
